_note: Episode 14 (S2E6) keyframes (from Kabanata 14, story version 1). Manila 1570: the burning of Rajah Matanda's palisaded fort is shown from afar, no gore. Rajah Matanda and Sulayman are generic figures from behind or the side; Matanda's diwa is light only. The kapre is the folklore tree giant and IS recorded. Present-day scenes have no dog: the sidecar is empty with Usman's red kerchief. Drink, strangers and the small bag are shown by suggestion only, never explicit; no substance is shown. M at the elevator: fully clothed, no intimacy shown. The man with the triangle mark is unnamed. No flood control anywhere. Copied from Episode 13: full intro. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
